l4_steps.name: Ingest flight activity from PSS transaction feed
l4_steps.input: Post-departure flight coupons and e-ticket transaction records
l4_steps.output: Raw activity records loaded into loyalty staging table
l4_steps.kpi: Transaction ingestion latency ≤4 hours post-departure; error rate <0.1%
l4_steps.pain_point: PSS transaction feeds use EDIFACT format; schema mismatches between Altéa versions cause silent drop of codeshare and interline segments, under-crediting elite members

l4_steps.name: Validate fare class earning eligibility vs ATPCO rules
l4_steps.input: Fare basis code and booking class from ingested transaction
l4_steps.output: Earning eligibility flag (qualifying / non-qualifying) per segment
l4_steps.kpi: Eligibility rule coverage ≥99.5% of active fare families; <0.5% manual review rate
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO fare rules update fortnightly; loyalty rule tables often lag by 1–2 cycles, causing incorrect non-qualifying flags on newly filed promotional fares and generating member complaints

l4_steps.name: Post qualifying miles/segments/spend to member ledger
l4_steps.input: Validated earning eligibility flag and segment distance/revenue data
l4_steps.output: Qualifying Miles (QM), Qualifying Segments (QS), and Qualifying Spend (QSP) posted to member account
l4_steps.kpi: Ledger posting accuracy ≥99.9%; retro-credit request rate <2% of eligible transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Partner airline codeshare miles require a separate interline settlement file; delays of up to 72 hours in partner data delivery create visible ledger gaps that prompt unnecessary member calls to contact centre

l4_steps.name: Aggregate qualifying credits against tier thresholds
l4_steps.input: Rolling 12-month QM, QS, and QSP ledger totals per member
l4_steps.output: Tier progress score and distance-to-next-tier metric per member
l4_steps.kpi: Batch refresh cycle ≤6 hours; member progress accuracy vs ledger ±0 credits
l4_steps.pain_point: Real-time tier progress is surfaced via mobile app; Redshift batch latency causes app to show stale progress bars, triggering trust complaints from high-value members after qualifying flights

l4_steps.name: Apply partner airline and credit card earning multipliers
l4_steps.input: Base qualifying credits and active partner multiplier rules
l4_steps.output: Adjusted qualifying total inclusive of promotional and partner bonuses
l4_steps.kpi: Multiplier application accuracy ≥99.8%; promotional credit disputes <0.3% of bonus transactions
l4_steps.pain_point: Co-branded credit card spend multipliers are fed by card issuer APIs on a monthly settlement cycle; mid-month tier assessments cannot include unsettled spend, causing members to miss tier upgrades they would have earned had the spend posted on time

l4_steps.name: Flag members within 10% of next tier threshold
l4_steps.input: Tier progress score from Redshift; tier threshold configuration
l4_steps.output: Proactive tier-progress nudge email or push notification sent to member
l4_steps.kpi: Nudge email open rate ≥35%; incremental qualifying activity uplift ≥8% among nudged cohort
l4_steps.pain_point: Personalisation tokens for nudge emails pull live balance from Altéa Loyalty API; API rate limits during peak send windows cause token failures, resulting in generic messages that undermine member engagement

l4_steps.name: Assess whether tier upgrade threshold has been met
l4_steps.input: Adjusted qualifying total; tier programme threshold table
l4_steps.output: Tier upgrade trigger event or no-action record
l4_steps.kpi: Tier threshold assessment latency ≤1 hour of qualifying transaction posting; false-positive rate <0.01%
l4_steps.pain_point: Concurrent qualifying flights on the same calendar day can create race conditions in the threshold check, causing duplicate tier upgrade events that provision double benefit sets until a nightly reconciliation job corrects them

l4_steps.name: Award new tier status in Amadeus Altéa Loyalty
l4_steps.input: Tier upgrade trigger event from step 2.4
l4_steps.output: Member profile updated with new tier code and tier validity dates
l4_steps.kpi: Tier award processing time ≤30 minutes from trigger; tier award error rate <0.05%
l4_steps.pain_point: Tier validity date logic varies by programme (calendar-year vs rolling-12-month); incorrect configuration during programme rule changes has granted tier status with wrong expiry dates, requiring costly retroactive corrections

l4_steps.name: Provision upgrade coupons and lounge access in PSS
l4_steps.input: New tier code from step 3.1; benefit entitlement table per tier
l4_steps.output: Upgrade coupons (eUTCs), lounge access certificates, and priority boarding flags active in PNR
l4_steps.kpi: Benefit provisioning completion ≤2 hours of tier award; coupon redemption error rate at airport <0.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Benefit provisioning relies on Altéa OSI/SSR message injection into the PNR; check-in agents at third-party handling stations without direct Altéa access may not see provisioned benefits, causing lounge access denials and escalations

l4_steps.name: Dispatch tier upgrade congratulation and benefit summary
l4_steps.input: Tier award event; member contact preferences; benefit entitlement copy
l4_steps.output: Personalised congratulation email with new tier benefits, card dispatch confirmation, and portal link
l4_steps.kpi: Email delivery within 2 hours of tier award; delivery success rate ≥98%; unsubscribe rate <0.2%
l4_steps.pain_point: Physical elite card production is outsourced; card delivery SLA of 10 business days conflicts with member expectation of immediate tangible recognition, generating contact centre calls in the interim window

l4_steps.name: Receive upgrade request at booking or check-in gate
l4_steps.input: Member upgrade coupon or tier-based complimentary upgrade entitlement
l4_steps.output: Upgrade request queued against target cabin class inventory
l4_steps.kpi: Upgrade request capture rate ≥99% of eligible members; request queue processing time ≤60 seconds
l4_steps.pain_point: Upgrade request channels (online check-in, kiosk, agent) do not share a single priority queue; the same coupon can be presented simultaneously across channels, creating duplicate upgrade requests that consume inventory incorrectly

l4_steps.name: Check upgrade class seat inventory availability in PSS
l4_steps.input: Upgrade request; flight date/route; target cabin upgrade bucket (e.g., C class)
l4_steps.output: Inventory availability confirmation or waitlist placement decision
l4_steps.kpi: Upgrade clearance rate for top-tier members ≥70% on eligible routes; waitlist clear rate ≥50% by T-24h
l4_steps.pain_point: Upgrade inventory buckets are controlled by Revenue Management; RM teams frequently close upgrade classes on high-demand flights up to T-72h, leaving top-tier members waitlisted on routes where premium seats are visible but commercially blocked

l4_steps.name: Process upgrade rebook or manage waitlist clearance
l4_steps.input: Confirmed upgrade inventory; priority-ranked waitlist
l4_steps.output: Upgraded PNR with new cabin class; deducted upgrade coupon; or maintained waitlist record
l4_steps.kpi: Upgrade processing time ≤5 minutes at check-in; coupon deduction accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Automated upgrade engines do not always respect manual override priorities set by premium service desks for VVIP members; automated processing can displace a manually held upgrade, requiring agent correction under time pressure at the gate

l4_steps.name: Reissue boarding pass with new cabin assignment
l4_steps.input: Confirmed upgraded PNR; new seat assignment in target cabin
l4_steps.output: Reissued boarding pass with updated class of service and seat number
l4_steps.kpi: Boarding pass reissue time ≤2 minutes; boarding document error rate <0.01%
l4_steps.pain_point: Mobile boarding pass updates via Altéa's push mechanism require the member's app to be online at time of upgrade; offline devices display the original boarding pass, creating security lane discrepancies and boarding delays

l4_steps.name: Log tier dispute or competitive status match claim in CRM
l4_steps.input: Member dispute submission (missing credits, incorrect tier, status match request) with supporting documents
l4_steps.output: Case record created in Salesforce with category, priority, and SLA timer
l4_steps.kpi: Case creation time ≤5 minutes; first response SLA ≤4 business hours for elite members
l4_steps.pain_point: Status match requests from competing programme members require manual verification of competitor tier documentation; no automated data exchange with competing programmes means agents must visually verify screenshots, which are easily manipulated

l4_steps.name: Review documentation and approve or reject dispute
l4_steps.input: Case record; flight/transaction records from Altéa Loyalty; submitted evidence
l4_steps.output: Dispute resolution decision (approved / rejected) with rationale documented
l4_steps.kpi: Dispute resolution time ≤5 business days; first-contact resolution rate ≥80%; approval accuracy vs policy ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Agents lack a single-screen view joining Salesforce case data with Altéa Loyalty transaction history; switching between systems to verify activity increases handle time and introduces manual transcription errors in the resolution record

l4_steps.name: Apply manual tier or credit adjustment in loyalty system
l4_steps.input: Approved dispute decision from step 5.2; adjustment quantity and type
l4_steps.output: Manual credit or tier amendment applied to member account; case closed in Salesforce
l4_steps.kpi: Adjustment posting accuracy 100%; case closure within 1 business day of approval
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual tier adjustments bypass the standard threshold assessment workflow, meaning benefit provisioning in the PSS must also be triggered manually; agents without elevated permissions cannot complete both steps, creating a handoff gap where tier is awarded but benefits are not yet active

l4_steps.name: Run end-of-qualifying-period tier review batch job
l4_steps.input: Member qualifying credit totals for the expiring programme year; tier threshold table
l4_steps.output: Tier renewal, downgrade, or extension recommendation dataset
l4_steps.kpi: Batch job completion within 4-hour overnight window; zero failed member records; data reconciliation variance <0.01%
l4_steps.pain_point: Annual batch job processes millions of member records in a single overnight window; AWS Redshift cluster scaling has historically underestimated job duration, causing batch overruns that delay morning check-in benefit reads at airports on the first day of the new programme year

l4_steps.name: Assess requalification threshold met or missed
l4_steps.input: Recommendation dataset from step 6.1; requalification threshold per tier level
l4_steps.output: Member disposition: renew at current tier / upgrade tier / downgrade tier / place on grace period
l4_steps.kpi: Requalification assessment accuracy ≥99.99%; zero incorrect downgrades of members who requalified
l4_steps.pain_point: Grace period eligibility rules (e.g., extended status for members within 500 miles of requalification) are configured manually in Altéa; rule misconfiguration during programme refreshes has incorrectly downgraded members who should have received a grace extension, resulting in high-value member attrition

l4_steps.name: Execute tier renewal, downgrade, or extension notification
l4_steps.input: Member disposition from step 6.2; communication template per tier outcome
l4_steps.output: Personalised renewal/downgrade/extension email with new tier validity, benefit summary, and re-earn guidance
l4_steps.kpi: Notification delivery within 24 hours of batch completion; downgrade appeal rate <5% among downgraded members
l4_steps.pain_point: Downgrade communications must be carefully sequenced to avoid triggering opt-outs; generic downgrade emails sent without personalised re-earn incentives have historically caused measurable NPS drops among former top-tier members who subsequently churn to competitor programmes
